title: Water pipe is leaking on the road
description: Clean drinking water is leaking from a broken pipe on the road. Water is wasting quickly. Please fix it soon.

mlPrediction.diagnosisReason: Underground pipeline pressure dropped by 1.05 bar (nominal 2.40 -> 1.35 bar) with tap delivery starvation (0.25 bar) and surging flow (560 L/min). High probability of fractured underground pipe.

sensorData.simpleDiagnosis: ML model predicts 95% Broken Pipe Probability based on 1.05 bar pipeline pressure drop & 0.25 bar tap pressure starvation.
sensorData.alertMessage: Sensors report: Underground pipe fracture detected from pressure variation (Pipeline: 1.35 bar, Tap: 0.25 bar).

officerNotes: Checked the spot. Closed main valve to stop water waste.
Workers arrived with new pipe parts. Fixing the leak now.

timeline.title: Officer Assigned
timeline.description: Assigned to Water Officer Rajesh Kumar.

timeline.title: Fixing on Site
timeline.description: Workers are fixing the broken pipe on the road.

title: Tap water is brown and dirty
description: Tap water is muddy and brown today. It smells bad and cannot be used for drinking or cooking.

mlPrediction.diagnosisReason: Storage Tank contamination detected: High turbidity (4.80 NTU) and conductivity (780 µS/cm). Underground pipeline pressure variation is minimal (0.25 bar).

sensorData.simpleDiagnosis: Elevated Tank turbidity (4.80 NTU) and conductivity (780 µS/cm). Silt sediment detected in storage reservoir.
sensorData.alertMessage: Sensors report: Storage tank turbidity spike (4.80 NTU) and conductivity deviation (780 µS/cm).

officerNotes: Visiting today to collect a water sample for testing.

timeline.title: Officer Assigned
timeline.description: Given to Officer Rajesh Kumar to test the line.

title: No water in house taps
description: No water came from taps for 2 days. House storage tanks are completely empty.

officerRating.feedback: Officer checked the water motor, fixed wiring quickly, and water is back.

mlPrediction.diagnosisReason: Nominal operational gradient: Pipeline at 2.40 bar, consumer tap at 1.35 bar, and pristine Tank purity (0.40 NTU).

sensorData.simpleDiagnosis: Water motor repaired. Optimal parameters across Tank, Pipeline, and Tap.
sensorData.alertMessage: Sensors report optimal parameters (Tank: 0.40 NTU, Pipeline: 2.40 bar, Tap: 1.35 bar).

officerNotes: New switch fitted. Normal water supply restored.

timeline.description: Electrician team sent by Rajesh Kumar.
